{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_ereg_named_subpatterns.phpt","function":"<global>","line":11,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg('(?<wsp>\\s*)(?<word>\\w+)', '  中国', $m);","note":"Named subpatterns and quantified groups are accepted and compiled through the mbregex path."},
{"step":3,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"PHP_FUNCTION(mb_ereg)","line":0,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg forwards the supplied pattern into php_mbregex_compile_pattern and Oniguruma","note":"The attacker-controlled regex pattern reaches Oniguruma's parser and optimizer via mbstring."},
{"step":4,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_regex_ereg_exec","line":900,"var":"arg_pattern","code":"re = php_mbregex_compile_pattern(arg_pattern, arg_pattern_len, options, MBREX(current_mbctype), MBREX(regex_default_syntax));","note":"Compilation is the key entry point where the vulnerable AST analysis runs."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5441,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"Quantifier tuning recursively inspects the quantified body to classify empty-repeat behavior and memory-node interactions."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"static enum BodyEmptyType quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"This recursive AST walk is the suspected root cause path from the crash report, matching the reported state names."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4904,"var":"NODE_CAR(node)","code":"v = quantifiers_memory_node_info(NODE_CAR(node));","note":"Nested list/alt nodes are traversed recursively, so a crafted pattern can force repeated visits through the same logical subtree."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5629,"var":"r","code":"r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The compiler propagates the analysis result into memory/backtrack bookkeeping, setting up the later invalid access."},
{"step":9,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"_php_mb_onig_search","line":880,"var":"err","code":"err = onig_search_with_param(reg, str, end, start, range, region, option, mp);","note":"The compiled regex is executed against the subject string; if the vulnerable compiler state is reached, the crash manifests during regex processing."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
